precision_definition: relevant unique returned IDs / k; returned precision reported separately
ap_definition: sum of precision at relevant ranks within k / all known relevant IDs
ndcg_definition: gain=2**grade-1; log2(rank+1); binary only for current judgments
no_gold: retrieval N/A; evaluate clarification, refusal, unavailable data separately
fairness: same corpus/query/tokenizer/BM25 k1=1.5,b=.75/top-k; paired baseline and ablation; snippets share 400-char non-web budget
annotation: Narrative Matin responses preserved as lineage. New references and answer outputs require explicit review; no invented K/R/D/S/A scores.
inference: Development descriptive only. Freeze family-separated approved test before final comparison. API errors separate from legitimate zero; report N/A and missing denominators.
